sources.title: Convolutional Neural Network and CIFAR10 Dataset
sources.snippet: The invention of CNNs has significantly improved the accuracy of image recognition AI, surpassing human performance levels. Nowadays, most modern image recognition AI systems rely on CNNs. We will build a simple CNN model and train it using the CIFAR10 dataset.
